verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a government business-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence documents many UI-driven online filings (formations, annual reports, amendments, dissolutions, certificates) but never mentions an API or programmatic access. Browser support notes describe a web application only, and the robots.txt probe says nothing about an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
